module.name: RHD Flags
module.author: UW DIGI
module.description: Scheduled re-evaluation of patient flags whose criteria depend on the passage of time.

globalProperty.description: How often both scheduled tasks run, in seconds. Read only when a task is first registered, because after that the interval belongs to the scheduler and overwriting it here would discard whatever an administrator set in Manage Scheduler. To change it on a running instance, edit the task there.

Only flags carrying this tag are mirrored into a patient list. Leave empty to give every enabled flag a list. Useful where some flags are a clinical signal on the chart and are not worth a worklist of their own.
